item.title: Emulating the Intel 8080 to play space invaders
Building a 3D graphics engine in C++ from first-principles
About
item.description: I enjoy building things from first principles. I am interested in electrical and computer engineering, specifically silicon design, hardware and microprocessors and am excited to learn about other areas within computer engineering. I will use this page to document my projects and interest in hardware. I studied at King’s Maths School between 2024-2026, a specialist mathematics school for 16-18 year olds in London ran in partnership with King’s College London. Currently, I am a first-year undergraduate studying engineering at the University of Cambridge and a member of Churchill College.
